name: 电商商品上架
description: 从商品资料写出一套上架文案：卖点 → 标题 → 主图和详情页、客服问答（并行）→ 检查。适合淘宝、拼多多、抖店、亚马逊。 / Write a full product listing from your product notes: selling points → titles → main images and detail page, plus customer Q&A (in parallel) → check. For Taobao, Pinduoduo, Douyin shops and Amazon.

product.description: 商品名称，例如：便携榨汁杯 / The product, e.g. a portable blender cup

platform.description: 上架平台：taobao 淘宝/天猫，pinduoduo 拼多多，douyin 抖店，amazon 亚马逊。决定语气和重点 / Where it is sold. Sets tone and emphasis

audience.description: 目标买家 / Who buys it

titleMax.description: 标题最多几个字（按平台规则填写，淘宝常用 30 个汉字）/ Maximum title length in characters (follow your platform's rule)

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 商品资料
stages.description: 写下商品的真实参数、材质、包装和售后。后面的文案只能用这里的事实。 / Write down the real specs, materials, package contents and after-sales terms. Every later line of copy must come from these facts.

executor.instructions: 把 materials/product.md 换成你的商品资料：参数、材质、包装清单、售后、和同类商品比的优点。示例是虚构的榨汁杯。 / Replace materials/product.md with your product's facts: specs, materials, what is in the box, after-sales terms, and how it beats similar products. The sample is a fictional blender cup.

stages.name: 卖点
stages.description: 从资料里提炼 3 到 6 个卖点，每个都写明依据，并列出买家会搜的关键词。 / Pull 3 to 6 selling points from the facts, each with its evidence, plus the keywords buyers search for.

stages.name: 标题
stages.description: 写 3 个候选标题，带上关键词，不超过字数上限。 / Write 3 candidate titles that carry the keywords and stay within the length limit.

stages.name: 主图和详情页
stages.description: 5 张主图的文案和画面，再加详情页的每一屏。 / Copy and visuals for 5 main images, then each screen of the detail page.

stages.name: 客服问答
stages.description: 买家最常问的问题和回答，和详情页并行。不知道的不编。 / The questions buyers ask most, with answers, in parallel with the detail page. Nothing invented.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查标题长度、关键词、广告法常见违禁词和占位符。 / Check title length, keywords, absolute claims that ad rules commonly ban, and placeholders.
